question: Will this padlock icon be shown on mid-grey backgrounds in the game? It decides whether the last pass should darken the lock's left edge for contrast (a small visible change to the look you liked).
selectedOptionText: Don't change the left edge. Record the weak contrast on mid-grey as a trade-off you accept. The reviewers' formal recommendation stays no-go on that one point, but your finished-art approval is a separate decision you can still make.
effect: Requester-accepted trade-off: inherited checker-contour objection (body-light left edge 1.50 and shackle-base outer 1.97 against #C0C0C0) is not corrected in pass 2. It remains an unresolved adversarial objection for the formal visual recommendation; it is not resolved by this decision.
